description: Files a feature request for Appeal Draft on Brick & Mortar's public request board (brickandmortar.dev/requests), where anyone can read and upvote it, and notifies the person who builds Appeal Draft. For something Appeal Draft does not do or hold yet: a county or city it does not cover, condos or another property type, a number it does not return. title is the person's own words, verbatim and short; detail is optional; contact is an email or handle exactly as they offered it, sent to the builder only and never shown on the board. ok true means it was filed.

contact.description: Optional: email or handle for a reply, verbatim, only if offered

detail.description: Optional: what they were trying to do

title.description: What they want, in their own words, ideally under 90 characters

name: request_a_feature
title: Request a Appeal Draft feature
